inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Empty Bloodridge sunken crypt battle stage, rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: golden hour, a warm low sun behind the ruins, rays of light through the leaves, lush vines and flowers overgrowing white marble ruins, cool blue violet shadows, fireflies, rich harmonious colour and lighting.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "modern high quality pixel art battle stage, golden hour light, lush, harmonious colour", "lighting": "Warm golden sunlight from behind and above the ruins, cool blue violet shadows as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the arena in calm even cool shade, a few soft light shafts.", "color_palette": ["#6290d2", "#fad096", "#9692c4", "#f6e4c4", "#7c78aa", "#ecb050", "#b46e3c", "#56925c", "#96a0bc", "#1c4246", "#282848"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D battle stage seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade fighting game stage, no figures, no text. The top third is sky above a distant ridge, seen through a gap right of centre. The back of the stage is a row of ruins framed by a tall piece at each edge, the crypt left of centre and a huge tree on the right. The lower two thirds is one wide open flat arena floor where two armies will stand, calm and even, clearly separated from the back. The bottom corners hold dark foreground framing pieces in shadow.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 400, 120], "desc": "a tall white marble pillar wrapped in flowering vines"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [80, 190, 410, 470], "desc": "a white marble crypt temple overgrown with lush vines, warm sunlight on its face, a dark doorway"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [260, 465, 400, 650], "desc": "low white walls with ferns and flowers"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [150, 470, 330, 760], "desc": "a far violet mountain ridge with a small stepped pyramid court in golden haze"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 640, 410, 920], "desc": "a huge lush tree with golden autumn leaves and light shafts through its canopy"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [30, 910, 400, 1000], "desc": "a ruined white arch with hanging moss"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [400, 70, 980, 930], "desc": "a pale stone arena in cool blue shade, calm and even, grass along its edges"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [820, 0, 1000, 200], "desc": "dark teal foliage with fireflies"}]}}
